meaning: Attempts against the roster, appended after each run: reused live recordings, new live runs (promoted to sanitized fixtures), replay and labelled synthetic cases, each with per-behavior status (observed, attempted-not-triggered, not-run, blocked) and raw predicates the Java check evaluates on the committed native recording. Only an attempt of evidence class live can make a behavior live-observed. SEM-1: canonical names the oracle properties whose results, run on the attempt's own committed recording, constitute the behaviour's canonical assertion; LiveScenarioTest judges them as the coverage summary does (every owner established, or absent with zero native occurrences) and reports them per attempt.
